ValidationRule.description: JP CSC/COC Communicator and Leader cannot mark Risk level as High or Extremely High.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(CONTAINS( $UserRole.Name,'Communicator'),CONTAINS( $UserRole.Name,'Leader')), OR( ISPICKVAL( Risk_Level__c, 'High'), ISPICKVAL(Risk_Level__c, 'Extremely High') ), ISCHANGED(Risk_Level__c), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Communicator/Leader is not allowed to mark risk level of an IMCR case.
